title: Dubai Real Estate Market Holds Strong as 85% of Landlords Choose to Retain Properties
summary_ru: 📰 Dubai Real Estate Market Holds Strong as 85% of Landlords Choose to Retain Properties The residential property market in Dubai continues to demonstrate remarkable stability, with nearly 85% of landlords choosing to hold onto their assets despite rising geopolitical tensions across the Middle East. This trend reinforces confidence that the emirate’s real estate sector remains fundamentally strong and driven by long-term value rather than short-term sentiment. According to a recent report by proptech firm Smart Bricks , most landlords have maintained their investment positions following regional developments that began in late February. #Дубай #ОАЭ #Новости
